title: debian: Bring packaging closer to the state in Debian and derivatives
description: Ubuntu 18.04 and Debian oldoldstable both have debhelper 12 in backports.

notes.body:
added 8 commits
  • 51e1381b - 1 commit from branch wireshark:master
  • aed6c130 - debian/copyright: Fix typo and remove patterns for removed files
  • d74afba1 - debian: Make wireshark depend on the same version of wireshark-qt
  • d87bc0d7 - debian/control: Drop Conflists: and Replaces: referring to very old versions
  • a9c1d1ac - debian: Bump compat level to 12 keeping backports in mind
  • a1d964fa - debian/rules: Turn on BUILD_corbaidl2wrs to ship idl2wrs man page
  • 6617c7fc - debian/rules: Don't pass --parallel to dh, it is the default now
  • ba4bec7d - debian: Report upstream and package version instead of git revision
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/4554/diffs?diff_id=258967405&start_sha=27de3e781de1e587aeda190364a512acf62b3a68)

Hi,
Pacakaging now fails for me on Ubutu 18.04.
![image](/uploads/dd734ed351bae12659fe9aef2d3aace0/image.png)
